confidence.rationale: The Win32 keyboard hook contract requires hooks to process only HC_ACTION callbacks; other codes must be passed to the next hook.

proposed_comments.title: Process only actionable keyboard hook callbacks
proposed_comments.body:
### Process only actionable keyboard hook callbacks

**Severity:** `high`

`WH_KEYBOARD` can call the hook with non-`HC_ACTION` codes, including peek/no-remove callbacks. Treating every non-negative code as a real key action can run the Alt+number suppression path more than once for the same key state, so the shortcut may invoke twice. Only process `HC_ACTION`; all other codes should be forwarded unchanged.

```suggestion
            if (nCode == 0)
```

proposed_comments.title: Add end-to-end coverage for numbered shortcut invocation and selection
proposed_comments.body:
### Add end-to-end coverage for numbered shortcut invocation and selection

**Severity:** `medium`

This feature depends on the local keyboard hook, Alt latching, WinUI focus, and the distinction between invoking and selecting. Add UI automation coverage for Alt+1 invocation, latched Alt then 1 invocation, and Alt+Shift+1 selecting without invoking so regressions in the hook and focus path fail deterministically.
